notes: Tripartite *Jehovah he is God*: ASV writes *he* for the resuming הוּא, so the pronoun holds its own word and the copula joins the predicate אֱלֹהִים (rule 20).

Cleft *It is he that hath made us*: *It is* added (rule 20 cleft paragraph); *he ... that* given to the explicit הוּא, which rule 20 names as taking a *that* the ASV writes for it. Competing reading leaves *that* as a separate added cleft relative under rule 55.

וְלוֹ אֲנַחְנוּ: לְ is the verbless clause's predicate and its relation is written inside the genitive *his*, so לְ and suffix fuse with the copula under rule 49's closing paragraph (the boundary rule 40 draws). Second *We* is the resumed אֲנַחְנוּ under rule 25.
Variant WLC.PSA.100.3.v001 selected base reading (וְלוֹ); ASV margin reports the other reading and was set aside (rule 38).
